narrative.executive_summary: Your platform currently faces systemic inventory execution risk across 11 live missions, with 9 active MEDIUM-severity detections (risk scores 39-47). The primary exposure is concentrated in 36 high-velocity SKUs — led by Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units), and Mouse (28 units) — where chronic understock and supplier concentration threaten immediate lost sales. Compounding this, the replenishment engine is flagging 15-30 products for immediate reorder while simultaneously recommending 0 units, indicating a critical calculation logic failure that leaves demand unfulfilled. Two missions returned zero data, creating blind spots in stockout and variant performance visibility that require urgent remediation to prevent revenue leakage.

threat_vectors.description: 21-36 high-velocity products are understocked, led by Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30), Mouse (28) and Sugar (23). Risk scores of 47 indicate imminent lost sales and single-supplier dependency for top-demand categories.

threat_vectors.name: Replenishment Logic Failure - Zero-Volume Paradox
threat_vectors.description: 5 missions flag 15-30 products for immediate replenishment but recommend 0 units total reorder volume (risk 39-42). System is detecting risk but failing to execute corrective orders, leaving shelves exposed.

threat_vectors.name: Aged Inventory & Fragmented Stock Drag
threat_vectors.description: 30 products trapped in decaying velocity with aged inventory (risk 42) and 21 products with splinter stock below fulfillable quantity. Capital is locked in non-moving stock while fulfillable demand goes unmet.

immediate_actions: Manually override automated replenishment for top 4 velocity leaders (Oil 42, Biscuits 30, Mouse 28, Sugar 23) and expedite emergency purchase orders within 24 hours
Halt reliance on automated reorder volume and audit calculation engine for zero-unit bug — validate logic across all 5 affected missions before next replenishment cycle
Quarantine and review 30 aged inventory SKUs flagged in decaying velocity trap to liquidate, markdown, or reallocate capital within 72 hours
Consolidate 21 fragmented splinter stock locations below fulfillable quantity into centralized fulfillable inventory to restore order fill rate
monitoring_recommendations: Deploy daily velocity-to-cover dashboard for top 36 SKUs with automated alerts when stock cover falls below 7 days for Oil, Biscuits, and Mouse
Implement anomaly alert for any 'replenishment required but 0 units recommended' event to catch logic failures in real-time
Establish weekly supplier concentration and size-curve distortion review for high-velocity categories to diversify sourcing and correct channel-size mismatches
